phasing_details.phase_detail: Applying change of use from Class E to class C

description: Retrospective application for change of use from Class E to Class C1 to provide single bed pod overnight accommodation stays (maximum total of 17 no. sleeping pods).
decision_conditions: <p><span id="docs-internal-guid-367378d6-7fff-e90f-68c1-146f7bdd1ed9"></span></p><p dir="ltr" style="line-height:1.28;text-align: justify;margin-top:12pt;margin-bottom:12pt;"><span style="font-size:11pt;font-family:Arial,sans-serif;color:#000000;background-color:transparent;font-weight:400;font-style:normal;font-variant:normal;text-decoration:none;vertical-align:baseline;white-space:pre;white-space:pre-wrap;">Due to the absence of water efficiency measures and an Energy/Sustainability Statement,&nbsp; it is not possible to make an accurate and detailed assessment of the sustainability and climate change impacts of the proposal. .. As such,&nbsp; the proposal fails to be in accordance with policies LP54 (Overheating and Adapting to Climate Change),LP55 (Mitigating Climate Change), LP56 (Decentralised Energy Networks (DEN)) and LP57 (Waste) of the Hackney Local Plan (2020) and policies SI 2 (Minimising greenhouse gases), SI 3 (Energy infrastructure), SI 4 (Managing heat risk) and SI 7 (Reducing waste and supporting the circular economy).</span></p>

<p><span id="docs-internal-guid-18469bd6-7fff-e0e8-557c-ec3003c43fb3"></span></p><p dir="ltr" style="line-height:1.28;text-align: justify;margin-top:12pt;margin-bottom:12pt;"><span style="font-size:11pt;font-family:Arial,sans-serif;color:#000000;background-color:#ffffff;font-weight:400;font-style:normal;font-variant:normal;text-decoration:none;vertical-align:baseline;white-space:pre;white-space:pre-wrap;">The proposal results in an unacceptable loss of office floorspace within The Andre Street Priority Industrial Area without any submitted marketing evidence in accordance with Appendix 1 of LP33 to justify this loss of floorspace and with no evidence to justify why other priority uses such as conventional affordable housing have not been included. No marketing strategy in accordance with Appendix 1 has been provided to demonstrate that the retained first floor commercial space has a strong likelihood of being occupied,.&nbsp; </span><span style="font-size:11pt;font-family:Arial,sans-serif;color:#000000;background-color:transparent;font-weight:400;font-style:normal;font-variant:normal;text-decoration:none;vertical-align:baseline;white-space:pre;white-space:pre-wrap;">As such, the proposal is contrary to policies LP12 (Meeting Housing Needs and Locations for New Homes), LP25 (Visitor Accommodation), LP26 (Employment Land and Floorspace), LP27 (Protecting and Promoting Office Floorspace in the Borough) of the Hackney Local Plan (2020) and policy E1 (Offices) of The London Plan (2021).</span></p>

<p><span id="docs-internal-guid-743fd011-7fff-e7b1-ef0d-ccc2eb4c86c1"></span></p><p dir="ltr" style="line-height:1.28;text-align: justify;margin-top:12pt;margin-bottom:12pt;"><span style="font-size:11pt;font-family:Arial,sans-serif;color:#000000;background-color:#ffffff;font-weight:400;font-style:normal;font-variant:normal;text-decoration:none;vertical-align:baseline;white-space:pre;white-space:pre-wrap;">The proposal provides sub-standard visitor accommodation with poor light, outlook, and ventilation, and poor ancillary facilities in an&nbsp;unsuitable location, failing to meet minimum disability requirements and an active and legible ground floor frontage.&nbsp; &nbsp; The proposal fails to comply with policies LP1, LP12 (</span><span style="font-size:11pt;font-family:Arial,sans-serif;color:#000000;background-color:transparent;font-weight:400;font-style:normal;font-variant:normal;text-decoration:none;vertical-align:baseline;white-space:pre;white-space:pre-wrap;">Meeting Housing Needs and Locations for New Homes</span><span style="font-size:11pt;font-family:Arial,sans-serif;color:#000000;background-color:#ffffff;font-weight:400;font-style:normal;font-variant:normal;text-decoration:none;vertical-align:baseline;white-space:pre;white-space:pre-wrap;">), and LP25 (Visitor Accommodation) of the Hackney Local Plan (2020) and policies</span><span style="font-size:10.5pt;font-family:Arial,sans-serif;color:#000000;background-color:transparent;font-weight:400;font-style:normal;font-variant:normal;text-decoration:none;vertical-align:baseline;white-space:pre;white-space:pre-wrap;"> D4 (Delivering good design) and </span><span style="font-size:11pt;font-family:Arial,sans-serif;color:#000000;background-color:#ffffff;font-weight:400;font-style:normal;font-variant:normal;text-decoration:none;vertical-align:baseline;white-space:pre;white-space:pre-wrap;">T6.4 (</span><span style="font-size:11pt;font-family:Arial,sans-serif;color:#000000;background-color:transparent;font-weight:400;font-style:normal;font-variant:normal;text-decoration:none;vertical-align:baseline;white-space:pre;white-space:pre-wrap;">Hotel and leisure uses parking)</span><span style="font-size:11pt;font-family:Arial,sans-serif;color:#000000;background-color:#ffffff;font-weight:400;font-style:normal;font-variant:normal;text-decoration:none;vertical-align:baseline;white-space:pre;white-space:pre-wrap;"> of the London Plan (2021).</span></p>

<p><span id="docs-internal-guid-48d328a3-7fff-65d6-8cf6-dde7f4661d92"></span></p><p dir="ltr" style="line-height:1.2;text-align: justify;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:6pt;"><span style="font-size:11pt;font-family:Arial,sans-serif;color:#000000;background-color:transparent;font-weight:400;font-style:normal;font-variant:normal;text-decoration:none;vertical-align:baseline;white-space:pre;white-space:pre-wrap;">The change of use to a pod hotel in terms of noise and disturbance from the frequency &nbsp;and volume of visitors and the activities at the site associated with this use, as well as the unsatisfactory access arrangements, results in harm to the amenities of adjoining residents through noise and disturbance and antisocial behaviour. In addition, there is insufficient information relating to the mechanical plant that is in operation and causing nuisance to adjoining residents to assess this aspect of amenity impact. In the absence of an acoustic survey to include background noise levels and an assessment of existing unauthorised plant in operation, a detailed users survey, and an operational management plan, the use has an unacceptable amenity impact on neighbours. As such, the proposal fails to comply with policies LP1 xv. and LP2 of the Hackney Local Plan (2020) and the proposal would fail the agent of change principle&nbsp;due to the unacceptable impact on neighbouring properties of policies&nbsp; D13 (Agent of change) and D14 (Noise) of The London Plan (2021).</span></p>

<p><span id="docs-internal-guid-d3d8c724-7fff-eb87-559d-1fcebdb71240"></span></p><p dir="ltr" style="line-height:1.28;text-align: justify;margin-top:12pt;margin-bottom:12pt;"><span style="font-size:11pt;font-family:Arial,sans-serif;color:#000000;background-color:transparent;font-weight:400;font-style:normal;font-variant:normal;text-decoration:none;vertical-align:baseline;white-space:pre;white-space:pre-wrap;">Due to the absence of sufficiently detailed drawings, a Design and Access Statement, Planning Statement, and Operational Management Plan, it is not possible to make an accurate and detailed assessment of the change of use to a pod hotel.&nbsp; It would therefore fail to be in accordance with policies LP1 and LP2 of Hackney’s LP33 and policies D4 </span><span style="font-size:10.5pt;font-family:Arial,sans-serif;color:#000000;background-color:transparent;font-weight:400;font-style:normal;font-variant:normal;text-decoration:none;vertical-align:baseline;white-space:pre;white-space:pre-wrap;">(Delivering good design)</span><span style="font-size:11pt;font-family:Arial,sans-serif;color:#000000;background-color:transparent;font-weight:400;font-style:normal;font-variant:normal;text-decoration:none;vertical-align:baseline;white-space:pre;white-space:pre-wrap;"> and D13 (Agent of change) and D14 (Noise) of The London Plan (2021).</span></p>

<p><span id="docs-internal-guid-6d80cd2d-7fff-7a38-8029-a171e9227304"></span></p><p dir="ltr" style="line-height:1.28;text-align: justify;margin-top:12pt;margin-bottom:12pt;"><span style="font-size:11pt;font-family:Arial,sans-serif;color:#000000;background-color:transparent;font-weight:400;font-style:normal;font-variant:normal;text-decoration:none;vertical-align:baseline;white-space:pre;white-space:pre-wrap;">Due to the absence of a Travel Plan or sufficiently detailed Transport Statement, and full details of waste and recycling provision, it is not possible to make an accurate and detailed assessment of the highway impacts and the commitment to sustainable travel in the borough, associated with this change of use of the 2nd and 3rd floors to visitor accommodation. As such, the proposal&nbsp; fails to be in accordance with policies LP41 (Liveable neighbourhoods), LP42 (Walking and Cycling), LP43 (Transport and Development) and LP57 (Waste) of the Hackney Local Plan LP33 (2020) and policies T1 (Strategic Approach to Transport), T3 (Transport capacity, connectivity and safeguarding), T4 (Assessing and mitigating transport impact), T5 (Cycling), T6 (Car Parking) and T6.4 (Hotel and leisure uses parking), SI 7 (Reducing waste and supporting the circular economy) and SI 8 (Waste capacity and net waste self sufficiency) of The London Plan (2021).</span></p>
